           COUNT_BIG(*) AS exposure_count,
           COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS patient_count
    FROM descendant_drugs dd
    JOIN omop.drug_exposure de ON de.drug_concept_id = dd.descendant_concept_id
    JOIN adhd_patients ap ON ap.person_id = de.person_id
    GROUP BY dd.ingredient_concept_id, dd.medication, dd.pathway_alignment
